description: The line plot titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature" illustrates the Pass@8 accuracy of three different methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—across varying generation temperatures. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," is a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at every 0.1 interval. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," is also a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at every 2.5 interval. The On-policy RL line, represented by yellow triangles, shows a steady increase in accuracy from approximately 63.0 at 0.1 to 75.0 at 0.8, followed by a slight decline to 73.0 at 1.0. The LUFFY line, represented by red stars, demonstrates consistent superiority, starting at 76.0 at 0.1 and peaking at 81.0 at 0.8, before stabilizing at 80.0 at 1.0. The SFT line, represented by teal inverted triangles, begins at 73.0 at 0.1, dips sharply to 68.0 at 0.5, and recovers to 74.0 at 1.0, showing the most variability among the three methods. Overall, LUFFY consistently outperforms the other methods across all temperature settings, with On-policy RL showing the most significant improvement over time.

The 'SFT' line (teal, inverted triangle markers) begins at 73.0 at 0.1, dips sharply to 68.0 at 0.5, and recovers to 74.0 at 1.0, showing the most variability among the three methods.
